definitions.explanation: Matters relating to one's own personal life or situation. Most often appears in the set phrase {一身上|いっしんじょう}の{都合|つごう}, a polite, deliberately vague reason given when resigning or declining without disclosing details.

examples.japanese: {一身上|いっしんじょう}の{都合|つごう}で{退職|たいしょく}します。
examples.english: I am resigning for personal reasons.

examples.japanese: {一身上|いっしんじょう}の{理由|りゆう}で{欠席|けっせき}した。
examples.english: I was absent for personal reasons.

examples.japanese: {詳|くわ}しい{事情|じじょう}は{言|い}えないが、{一身上|いっしんじょう}の{都合|つごう}で{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}すことになった。
examples.english: I can't go into detail, but I've decided to move for personal reasons.

notes:
Almost always used in the fixed phrase {一身上|いっしんじょう}の{都合|つごう} ('personal circumstances'), a conventional and intentionally vague reason for resigning, declining, or being absent. It signals that the matter is private and not open to discussion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一身上|いっしんじょう}の{都合|つごう}: personal reasons; personal circumstances
- {一身上|いっしんじょう}の{理由|りゆう}: personal reasons
